description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grains, specifically testing behavior related to stuck grains, activation collection, deactivation, and forwarding mechanisms within the Orleans runtime. It uses Xunit for testing and sets up a test cluster configuration with custom options.

classes.name: StuckGrainTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying behavior of Orleans grains under conditions of being stuck, activation, deactivation, and forwarding.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Sets up and configures a test cluster with specific grain collection and silo options.

classes.name: SiloHostConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options such as collection age, quantum, and timeout options for the Orleans silo.

methods.name: StuckGrainTests
methods.description: Constructor for the test class, initializes the fixture.

methods.name: StuckGrainTest_Basic
methods.description: Tests basic functionality of a stuck grain including timeout, release, and garbage collection.

methods.name: StuckGrainTest_StuckDetectionAndForward
methods.description: Verifies detection of stuck grains and forwarding calls to new activations.

methods.name: StuckGrainTest_StuckDetectionOnDeactivation
methods.description: Tests detection of stuck grains during deactivation.

methods.name: StuckGrainTest_StuckDetectionOnActivation
methods.description: Checks behavior when activation is blocked and verifies activation retry behavior.
